name: Gahz'ranka
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/zul-gurub/gahzranka.md: Era 333,100 HP, 20-man, fished up once per lockout. There are no adds and one phase; he is modelled as one 180 s phase. Frost Breath, Massive Geyser and Slam have no published cadences, so every interval here is an estimate. Frost Breath's exact spell is unresolved: BW tracks 21099 (5 s slow, 30 yd), DBM 16099 (10 s), so the 10 s slow in the tip may be wrong. Boss melee (320 per 2 s) is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play and dies if the healer ignores a spike. Frost Breath's mana drain and slow are not modelled. Massive Geyser is a `hazard` that lands under a random raid member (35% chance it is you): a 2 s telegraph and 463 in a 10 yd radius, plus a follow-up `targetSwitch` for the threat drop as it erupts (the tank has to Taunt him back). The launch itself has no engine equivalent, so stepping out is the footwork the script scores; falling damage onto land is not modelled and the raid is assumed to fight over water. Slam is a radial `knockback` of 20 yd, weapon damage plus 250 and a shove. There is no line of sight, no water. The real fight has two tanks alternating after each launch, because the launched tank's threat is cut; the sim has one tank player who Taunts him back. Feign Death and Vanish on geysers are not modelled. Thrash is not modelled.

labels.text: Upper path: he evades if pulled here

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold him in the deep water with his back to the raid so only you eat Frost Breath. Every Massive Geyser drops him off you: Taunt him back at once.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stay behind him, out of the cone, and accept the Slam knockbacks. After a Massive Geyser, pause until the tank has him again.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stay in the water behind him, out of the cone. Attack on every global, but stop after a Geyser until the tank has him back.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Heal the tank through Frost Breath and every Slam, and heal the Geyser hits. Stay behind him, out of the cone.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Every attack adds threat. Watch the bar: in the red band one more hit pulls the boss off the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A big heal on the tank. Have it landing as the spike hits, not after.

frostBreath.label: Frost Breath
frostBreath.tip: A 2 s cone: about 1,000 Frost and a 10 s slow. Only the tank should be in it.

slam.label: Gahz'ranka Slam
slam.tip: A melee-range Slam that hits within 20 yd and shoves you away. Run back in.

massiveGeyser.label: Massive Geyser
massiveGeyser.tip: The water erupts under a random raid member within 40 yd: 2 s to step out of the 10 yd ring, 463 Frost if you are caught, and it drops his threat as it goes off. Tanks Taunt, DPS wait.

geyserThreatDrop.label: Threat dropped
geyserThreatDrop.toast: The launch dropped him off the tank
geyserThreatDrop.tip: The launched tank has lost him. Taunt.

expectations.label: Pull him out into the deep water
expectations.tip: Taunt him as he surfaces and walk him north into the deep water, so every launch lands you in water.

expectations.label: Keep him facing away from the raid
expectations.tip: Only you should be in the Frost Breath cone.

expectations.label: Taunt him back after each Geyser
expectations.tip: The launch dropped him off you. Taunt the moment you land.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: When the threat bar is in the red band, stop attacking until the tank is clear again.

expectations.label: Never stand in front of him
expectations.tip: Frost Breath drains mana and slows you. Stay behind him.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Slam and Frost Breath spike the tank. Keep heals rolling.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: The launched tank has been dropped: heal them as they land.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: In the red band one more hit can pull. Wait for the tank.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Every global you can safely use, use. Stop only when the bar is red or the boss is not on the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Nothing on the ground is worth a global. Step out, then carry on.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: A heal on a full tank is a heal you did not have for the spike.

cues.notes: Taunt after every Massive Geyser, Heal the tank.

list.label: Taunt when Gahz'ranka turns on the raid
list.tip: The moment the boss turns, Taunt. Every second it is on the raid someone is dying.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a spike coming is where tanks die. Heal now.

drills.name: Massive Geyser recovery
drills.description: Every 14 s the water launches you and he drops you: Taunt him back and walk him home.

drills.name: Stay behind him
drills.description: Frost Breath every 8 s. Stay out of the cone, keep attacking, and stop after a Geyser.

drills.name: Tank spike healing
drills.description: Keep the tank alive through Slam, Frost Breath and each launch.
